caption: The day-1 iron farm: for 11 iron (the shears for its leaves counted) and no quartz, three villagers scared by a zombie summon iron golems that burn in lava pits, about 295 iron an hour (62% of the game's ceiling). Three villagers sleep on their beds in closed 1-cell pods under leaves; a zombie in a boat 7 blocks north is in view of their standing and sleeping eyes. Golems spawn in a row of 8 1x1 pits west of the zombie, a lava source beside their head on both sides, and burn where they stand. One tripwire runs through every pit at knee height: a golem in any pit opens the trapdoor in front of the zombie, which hides it, and the villagers calm down (at night they fall asleep) while the golem burns. A water channel under the string carries the iron to one hopper. Hide the zombie by hand on the first night: the villagers need a recent sleep to summon the first golem. Game check (the real 26.3 server, this layout): 8 runs of 6 days, 72.8 golems/h (95% of the mean 70.3-75.3) against redsim's 74.8; 579 golems by day and 586 by night; spawn cells chi-square 6.25 over 8 cells (5% critical value 14.0).
